criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks basic understanding, definitions, or general facts about COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms & Testing
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19 symptoms, self-diagnosis, or testing recommendations.

categories.name: Prevention & Safety Measures
categories.definition: User seeks advice on how to prevent infection, protect themselves, or specific safety protocols.

categories.name: Transmission & Contagion
categories.definition: User asks how COVID-19 spreads, its viability on surfaces, or specific transmission vectors.

categories.name: Treatment, Cure & Vaccine
categories.definition: User inquires about available treatments, potential cures, or vaccine development status.

categories.name: Myths & Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks to debunk common myths, identify misinformation, or clarify false claims about COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics & Updates
categories.definition: User requests current data, news, or recent developments related to the pandemic.

categories.name: Impact on Animals & Pets
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19's effect on animals, pet transmission, or pet-related safety.

categories.name: Travel & Restrictions
categories.definition: User seeks information on travel advisories, restrictions, or safety related to transportation.

categories.name: Donation & Support
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate money, goods, or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Bot Interaction & Gratitude
categories.definition: User greets the bot, expresses thanks, or engages in general conversational pleasantries.

categories.name: Sharing Information (Bot/Content)
categories.definition: User expresses intent to share the bot, its content, or related articles with others.

categories.name: Personal Risk Assessment & Specific Scenarios
categories.definition: User describes a personal situation or specific scenario and asks for advice or risk assessment.
